items: The Church’s history: slavery, colonialism and anti-Judaism
why: The Church hates gay people and condemns who they are.
How Christians have read the Bible's laws on slavery, and what the Fathers said about it.
The ban is tied to helping a brother who has become poor.
Why the Church once forbade lending at interest, and how that teaching changed.
notes: These texts belong to the law of ancient Israel. Some limit slavery (release after six years, a runaway slave not to be returned). Some allow it, including of foreigners. Readers still argue about what they mean for us.
The law forbids interest on loans to a poor fellow Israelite, and allows it with foreigners. The Fathers and councils applied this to Christians.
